changelog: DeepSeek Harness: the reply pill now shows input/output tokens, cache hits, duration and the model that answered
DeepSeek Harness: switching the model no longer leaves the chat without an answer, and chats can be renamed from the sidebar
DeepSeek Harness: chat titles use your question instead of the hidden context block
DeepSeek Harness web page starts again after the container is stopped, and keeps its composer above the keyboard
Android Development: installed parts are recognised, each one has an Uninstall button, and a Stop the container button frees the battery
Security: the bridge's WebSocket and networking dependencies were moved to their patched versions
